pub assume_specification<T, E, U, F: FnOnce(T) -> Result<U, E>>[ Result::<T, E>::and_then ](
    result: Result<T, E>,
    op: F,
) -> (chained: Result<U, E>)
    requires
        result is Ok ==> op.requires((result->Ok_0,)),
    ensures
        result is Ok ==> op.ensures((result->Ok_0,), chained),
        result is Err ==> chained == Result::<U, E>::Err(result->Err_0),
;
ensures: result is Err ==> chained == Result::<U, E>::Err(result->Err_0)
candidates.rationale: The source calls op with the Ok payload and otherwise preserves the Err; vstd closure call predicates express the higher-order branch.

pub assume_specification<T, E, F: FnOnce(&T)>[ Result::<T, E>::inspect ](
    result: Result<T, E>,
    f: F,
) -> (inspected: Result<T, E>)
    requires
        result is Ok ==> f.requires((&result->Ok_0,)),
    ensures
        inspected == result,
        result is Ok ==> f.ensures((&result->Ok_0,), ()),
;
candidates.rationale: The source calls f on a shared reference to the Ok payload and then returns the original Result unchanged.

    result: Result<T, E>,
    f: F,
) -> (matches_err: bool)

    ensures
        result is Ok ==> !matches_err,
        result is Err ==> f.ensures((result->Err_0,), matches_err),
;
